title: Refractive Paint Palette
wikitext:
{{For|the [[Memento]] |Painter's Palette}} {{Infobox/Item |image = *Refractive Paint Palette |slot = *Refractive Paint Palette |type = Item |rarity = r |salable = n |tradeable = y |auctionable = y |id = REFRACTIVE_PAINT_PALETTE }} '''Refractive Paint Palette''' is a {{Rare}} item. == Obtaining == '''Refractive Paint Palette''' can be purchased from the {{Zone|Regalia Room}} for {{c|75m}}. As it is a rotating item, it may not be available every [[SkyBlock Year]]. == Usage == The '''Refractive Paint Palette''' tracks the player's lifetime dyes dropped and counts how many unique [[Dyes]] they drop up to {{Green|7}}. Finding {{Green|7}} unique [[Dyes]] will allow the player to consume the item and gain a permanent stat bonus of the following: *{{Green|+1%}} chance to find [[Dyes]] *{{stat|Intelligence|+1}} *{{stat|Carpentry Wisdom|+1}} The player may only gain the bonus once. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Guaranteed Message |- | class="ct" | Consuming | {{Dialogue|&aYou mix the 7 colors present on the palette into each other &aand behold the result. A new color, never seen before and &anever to be seen again, forms a brief second before being &awashed away. You feel a little bit more creative.}} |} == Tips == The following {{Green|7}} [[Dyes]] are recommended to max out the '''Refractive Paint Palette''', in order of easiest to hardest. Please note that, with the exception of [[Dyes]] acquired from [[Shops]] or {{Item|Ananke Feather}}s, they should be obtained as {{NPCSprite|Vincent}}'s selected {{Green|3x}} [[Dye]] as well as a {{Item|Bucket of Dye}} and {{attr|Miracle Chance}} attribute. The values will assume all three are used. {| class = "wikitable" ! Dyes !!
